description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'ProviderSearchFilterParams' used to encapsulate search filter parameters (name, status, id) for provider entities within the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: ProviderSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters for provider entities, including properties for name, status, and id, with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the provider name filter criterion.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the provider name filter criterion.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the provider status filter criterion.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the provider status filter criterion.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the provider ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the provider ID filter criterion.
